svg.title: Step 7 mockup 09: The crew phone: the night runs itself, the crew scores (crew, venue staff)
svg.text: 09 · The crew phone: nothing to do until something changes (crew, venue staff)
Use case: a crew member at the stage has a phone at 390 px and no laptop. The schedule runs the night; the phone shows what comes next and handles exceptions and scores.

svg.text: Nothing is a button just to start a step: the schedule starts it,
and the phone shows the next step and its time.
An override sits small under the next step for the rare day.
The crew acts to change something (reopen, delay, an exception)
